description: Given precondition, When action, Then outcome
Dummy, Stub, Spy, Mock, Fake - know the difference
example_structure:
Dummy: placeholder, never called
Stub: returns canned answers
Spy: records calls, allows verification
Mock: verifies expectations
Fake: working implementation (in-memory DB)
